commits.subject: PF20: build ks-21-6614-conviction-set from six pinned Kansas binaries
PF20: build ks-21-6614-diversion-set from the same six pinned Kansas binaries

theHEADLINE: Three of the six granted families are built from nothing, on six official Kansas binaries whose pinned digests all recompute. Two of the three return COMPLETED with all nine completeness counters zero. The third, ks-21-6614-conviction-set, returns STOPPED at requiredOptionsMissing 1 and is NOT released: its route election is the box reading "expungement of my conviction and related arrest records", the shared disposition_or_hearing protect rule matches the word "conviction" in that printed caption, and the channel that would say the caption is one the PARTICIPANT states rather than one the court owns — PARTICIPANT_STATED_SUBJECT in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs — carries entries for exact Alabama and Oregon captions and none for Kansas. That module is outside every one of this lane's ownedPaths and forty-odd families import it, so it was not edited, and the caption was not reworded to slip past the rule. The remaining three families are NOT built and NOT released, each for a different and stated reason.
sharedManifestsTouched: None. RASTER_QUEUE.json was NOT edited. MASTER_QUEUE.json was NOT edited. scripts/rcap-official-forms/** and scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/** were NOT edited — see theSHAREDMODULEGAP. Every commit touches only this lane's three build scripts, its three overlay directories, and pf20/.

sourceCustodyHonesty: The operational Nationwide Record Clearing tree is NOT mounted in this container. Five of the six binaries resolve through private/source-imports/Nationwide_Recovery_Pool_2026-09-02, which the committed corpus index declares a PARTIAL custody that "satisfies an individual source obligation and never a completeness assertion". That is exactly and only what was asked of it: six named documents at six exact digests, each verified byte-for-byte in the run. No completeness claim about the Kansas corpus is made anywhere.

howEachCounterWasTaken.everyCounterIsAMeasurement: No counter in any of these three families is a literal. Each is the length of a findings list produced by a named pass over this run's own field-map rows and this run's own saved artifact bytes. reports/completeness-counters.json carries howEachCounterWasTaken naming the pass for each of the nine.
howEachCounterWasTaken.knownRequiredFieldsMissing: Two passes, and the first one is the one that matters. FIRST: every row this family declared a WRITE for whose value the saved artifact does not carry is counted directly, from the fact of the suppression, before any classification runs. SECOND: classifyBlank from the repository's own scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/completeness-contract.mjs over every refusal row, counting KNOWN_FACT_NOT_WRITTEN.
howEachCounterWasTaken.requiredFactsNotCollected: every blank the contract classified REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, checked by substring against the GENERATED text of participant-instructions.md — the same string that is written to disk.
howEachCounterWasTaken.unclassifiedBlanks: the same classifyBlank pass, counting UNCLASSIFIED_BLANK.
howEachCounterWasTaken.incompleteRows: rowKeyOf over written and blank rows together; a row with any written cell and a REQUIRED_KNOWN blank cell is counted.
howEachCounterWasTaken.requiredOptionsMissing: the same classifyBlank pass, counting ROUTE_OPTION_NOT_SELECTED.
howEachCounterWasTaken.requiredComponentsMissing: the seven components the committed track registry declares for the family, minus the components this run actually produced bytes for.
howEachCounterWasTaken.invisibleWrites: per artifact, the finalizer's own written count against the glyphs and flattened widget appearances READ BACK out of the saved artifact; a document reporting writes with no readable ink is counted.
howEachCounterWasTaken.protectedWrites: classifyField over every WRITTEN row's label; a write onto a field the contract classes PROTECTED is counted.
howEachCounterWasTaken.visualDefects: per artifact, refused fields found carrying printed text at their own measured rectangle in the saved bytes, plus non-whitespace glyphs measured outside the write boxes.

rows.whyNotReleased: The builder returns STOPPED. A route-specific packet that does not state its route is not finished, and the completeness contract is right to say so.
rows.exactRemedy: One PARTICIPANT_STATED_SUBJECT entry in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs, exempting disposition_or_hearing for the exact caption of the petition's opening request — the petitioner's own request under K.S.A. 21-6614, which the petitioner states and no court owns — in the same shape as the existing al_cr65_participant_charge entry. Rebuilding this family then marks the box and the counter goes to zero. Nothing else about the family changes.
rows.blastRadiusOfThatRemedy: Measured, not estimated: 14,231 write and refusal labels across the 295 committed census-v1 production field maps in this tree were scanned for the phrase "expungement of my". Three carry it — the two Kansas boxes and one Vermont label reading "expungement of my criminal history is in the interests of justice", which a caption regex anchored on "and related arrest records" does not reach. A correctly anchored Kansas entry moves no other family's bytes.

rows.theThingAREVIEWERMUSTWEIGH: A packet whose route marker may never be marked is not distinguishable from an ordinary K.S.A. 21-6614(a) packet by its marks alone. It is distinguished by its one-year waiting-period treatment, its instructions, its guidance page and its K.S.A. 21-6617 referral. Whether official_pdf_fill on this shared petition is the right vehicle for subsection (b) at all is raised as a counsel question in the family's approval-request.json and is not answered by this lane.

familiesNOTBuilt.whyThisLaneStopped: Building it as a custom pleading would contradict the registry's declared output strategy and invent a filing vehicle; building it as official_pdf_fill would contradict MASTER_QUEUE's strategy and its own directory name. Choosing between them is a route-to-vehicle decision of exactly the kind PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING_DIAGNOSIS says is not a lane's to invent.

theSHAREDMODULEGAP.what: scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs decides, for every official_pdf_fill family in this corpus, what may be written into a field. A value binds only through FACT_DESCRIPTORS, and its protect rules relax only through PARTICIPANT_STATED_SUBJECT, whose entries are keyed to the exact printed captions of particular Alabama and Oregon forms. Kansas has no entry.
theSHAREDMODULEGAP.measuredConsequence: On these six binaries, with authored labels, the arresting agency, the crime charged, the offence of conviction, the conviction date, the convicting court, the date of final discharge, the arrest county, the arrest date, the year of birth, the sex and the name at the time of the case are all refused. Each is declared REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and disclosed to the participant, which is the same treatment 104 committed refusals across this corpus already give an arresting-agency blank. The one place it bites is the conviction family's route election, which cannot be dispositioned that way because the contract requires a route-specific packet to STATE its route.
theSHAREDMODULEGAP.whyThisLaneDidNotEditIt: It is outside every one of this lane's six ownedPaths, forty-odd families import it, and its own comments record that a lane holding a few families does not get to decide what the others' next rebuild produces. An additive, exactly-anchored Kansas entry is measured above as moving no other family's bytes, but making that change is still the module owner's call and not this lane's.
theSHAREDMODULEGAP.whatWasNOTDoneInstead: The printed caption was not reworded until the protect rule stopped matching it. The completeness contract calls that move out by name in the other direction — "wording a refusal to match a regex is the thing these counters exist to prevent" — and it is the same move whichever way it points.

theKSJCPERMISSIONHOLD.holdName: Kansas Judicial Council noncommercial-use and republication restriction
theKSJCPERMISSIONHOLD.quotedFromTheCommittedRecord: The Kansas Judicial Council states its forms are for non-commercial use and may not be sold, republished or transferred for value without express permission. Every Kansas official-form route is source-gated on that licence until permission is confirmed.
recordedIn: the Master Library's own STATES/KS/STATE_MANIFEST.csv notes column
theKSJCPERMISSIONHOLD.whatThisLaneDidAboutIt: Nothing, and it says so in every one of the three source receipts and approval requests. Building a packet is not resolving a permission hold and this lane has no authority to resolve one. The three families carry generationAllowed false, runtimeSelectable false and commercialRoutesOpened 0; they are internal build and review evidence. The hold stands exactly where it stood.
theKSJCPERMISSIONHOLD.doNotReadTHESEBUILDSASCLOSINGIT: MASTER_QUEUE's exactNextAction for all six families is "Resolve Kansas Judicial Council commercial reuse and republication treatment; all exact current source bytes are held." That action is untouched. Three families moving from NOT_RENDERED to RENDERED does not answer it and must not be read as answering it.

The appearance stream is decoded out of the artifact and its painting operators counted instead.

After every guard break the builder was restored and rebuilt, and the output hashed identical to the pre-break list a third time. git status --porcelain is clean of anything not intended.

The Master Library's STATES/KS/STATE_MANIFEST.csv records only 3 source-gated Kansas assets and 0 packet forms, and its notes column carries the KSJC republication restriction verbatim on the 2022 order. It is consistent with the track registry and with MASTER_QUEUE; nothing was changed.

With harvested captions and no authored labels, the repository's own decideBinding puts matter.county in the petition's year-of-birth blank, participant.email in both fax blanks, participant.state in the Criminal Cover Sheet's driver's-licence blank, matter.county in the notice's division and room blanks, and participant.full_legal_name in the order's "was granted a diversion for the crime of" blank. These three families author every label and are unaffected. Whether other families in this corpus rely on the harvested channel on forms with similar captions was NOT surveyed and is not a claim this lane makes.
grantsNothing: Three families moved from NOT_RENDERED to RENDERED and two of them return nine zero counters. That is a builder's own count over its own bytes and nothing more. It opens no commercial route, creates no fulfillment record, marks no packet proven, grants no output approval, and does not resolve the Kansas Judicial Council permission hold. Nothing in these three directories has been verified by anybody but the lane that built it, which is not verification.
independentVerificationOwed: Every family built here owes an independent fifteen-obligation verification by a lane that is not PF20 and did not author these builders, and a central hash-bound raster from the Captain-dispatched workflow. Neither is this lane's and neither was attempted. RASTER_QUEUE.json was not edited.
grantsReleased: Two of six. ks-21-6614-diversion-set and ks-21-6614-prostitution-coercion-set released, both COMPLETED with nine zero counters. ks-21-6614-conviction-set left HELD because its builder returns STOPPED. ks-21-6614-specialty-court-set left HELD on an unresolved vehicle contradiction. ks-22-2410-arrest-set and ks-22-4908-registration-relief-set left HELD because four of their six pinned binaries are absent from this container.
